title: Content Pack
description: Descriptor for a loadable content pack. Declares its type, the data files it provides, and any packs it depends on.

id.description: Unique identifier for this content pack.

name.description: Human-readable display name of the content pack.

schemaVersion.description: The schema version this pack descriptor conforms to.

type.description: Declares the primary category of content this pack provides, used to validate the files it lists.

contents.description: Relative paths (from the pack descriptor's directory) to every content file this pack contributes.

items.description: Relative file path to a JSON content file.

dependencies.description: Other content packs that must be loaded before this one.

id.description: ID of the required content pack.

version.description: Required version (semver range) of the dependency pack.
